command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); if test -n "$WS"; then WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const visible=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].filter(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Close"&&x.getClientRects().length);if(!visible.length)return "no-close";visible[visible.length-1].click();return "closed"})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){console.log("BLE_CLOSE="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' || true; fi; sleep 5
